evidence: Approved the 1.0.2 source policy for an unsigned stable release without adding code-signing or key-management infrastructure. SHA-256, closed manifest, SBOM, provenance, package smoke, archive safety, legal/redistribution review, protected publication, and immutable release identity remain mandatory. This source-policy approval does not replace release-owner acceptance of the final exact ZIP, its hashes and size, or its unsigned-distribution disposition before publication.
